Strategy: Refine the family with a piecewise rule: an exact fit wins, bins leaving more than one item compete by looseness, and tighter bins use Best Fit with a bonus for leftovers in [item/2, item]. The choice differs from Best Fit when a loose bin exists, since the loosest bin wins, and when the band bonus flips two tighter bins. Loose bins may preserve tight ones, but worst-fitting them can strand space.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if r - item > item else -(r - item) + (20 if item / 2 <= r - item <= item else 0)) for r in bins]
```
